title: Maxwell's demon and the low-entropy Big Bang are not sourced here
summary: The v1 entropy article's demon resolution and its cosmological arrow-of-time story were not tied to a located paper.
body: The v1 entropy article explains Maxwell's demon by saying the demon must use information, and it says the universe began in a low-entropy state whose reason is unknown. Both are serious topics. This pass did not attach a located paper to the demon resolution or to the "why was the early universe low entropy?" question. Leave them unsourced. Do not treat the cake and perfume examples as measurements.
